hooks.command: [ -f todos/todos.db ] && n=$(node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/todos.mjs" count open 2>/dev/null); [ "${n:-0}" != "0" ] && echo "master-brain: ${n} open todo(s) — run /mb:todos-list to review or /mb:todos-execute to work them." || true

echo "master-brain · delivery rule (two passes, in this order): (1) SUBSTANCE — run the anti-slop pass over any prose you produce (marketing copy, reports, emails, blog drafts, deliverables): /slop-review to find defects, /slop-rewrite to repair only what it lists, /slop-verify for citations, links and package names, /slop-code for code, tests and docs. It reports defects, never authorship. (2) STYLE — then pass the repaired text through the humanizer skill (mb:humanizer / /humanizer) so it reads human-written. Substance before style: stripping style markers off an unsourced paragraph only removes the warning label. Skip both only for code, raw data, or when the user asks for verbatim output."
